lines.text: Too hard for me to understand.
That lesson went over my head.

data.mean: Too hard for me to understand.
data.define: Used when something is too complex.

example.text: That lesson went over my head.

misuse.text: Don't say 'over my head' about a hat.
misuse.why: It means too hard to understand.
